# Exceptional People,
# Exceptional Outcomes

## A Medical Device Company Driven by a Shared Mission

As a global medical equipment manufacturer, we embrace a people-first culture that starts with a
mission to support our healthcare partners and the patients they serve. We design, build, and
distribute clinical products and surgical technologies for Orthopedic and General surgical
specialties, as well as patient monitoring needs, to medical institutions around the world —
enabling optimal patient outcomes.

[ Start a Conversation ][166]
[Four medical Professionals walking down a hallway]

### A Boldly Innovative Insufflation Solution

AirSeal^{®} is the only insufflator backed by clinical data* - positively affecting your patients'
intra and postoperative outcomes.

[ Learn More About AirSeal^{®} ][167]
[ Review the Data ][168]

### BioBrace^{®} Reinforced Bioinductive Implant

### The future of healing

The BioBrace^{®} implant combines the biological healing potential of highly porous Type I collagen
with the mechanical strength of PLLA microfilaments to support tendon healing. Engineered to protect
repairs during the vulnerable healing phase, the BioBrace^{®} implant promotes tissue growth,
reduces stress on healing tissue, and supports the body's natural healing processes.

[ Learn More About BioBrace^{®} ][169]
[ See the Data ][170]

### Y-Knotless™ Flex All-Suture Knotless Anchor: Shuttle with Ease. Fixate with Confidence.

The next generation of knotless technology is here with Y-Knotless™ Flex. Engineered for effortless
shuttling and designed to provide color-coded clarity during each step of the procedure.

[ Learn More About Y-Knotless™ Flex ][171]

As a global medical equipment manufacturer, we embrace a people-first culture that starts with a
mission to support our healthcare partners and the patients they serve. We design, build, and
distribute clinical products and surgical technologies for Orthopedic and General surgical
specialties, as well as patient monitoring needs, to medical institutions around the world —
enabling optimal patient outcomes.

### BioBrace^{®} Reinforced Bioinductive Implant

### The future of healing

The BioBrace^{®} implant combines the biological healing potential of highly porous Type I collagen
with the mechanical strength of PLLA microfilaments to support tendon healing. Engineered to protect
repairs during the vulnerable healing phase, the BioBrace^{®} implant promotes tissue growth,
reduces stress on healing tissue, and supports the body's natural healing processes.

shuttling and designed to provide color-coded clarity during each step of the procedure.

## The History of Henry Schein

[Henry Schein Cares]

In 1932, at the height of the Depression, a pharmacist named Henry Schein started our company with
the belief that we can fulfill our responsibilities as a corporate citizen by giving back to the
communities we serve. Ever since then, we have pursued the ideal of "doing well by doing good." This
spirit of individuals helping society is exemplified through Henry Schein Cares, our global
corporate social responsibility program.

inspire our science-based innovations, which continue to change and save lives. With rigorous

medicines of tomorrow. Healthcare areas include: Oncology, Immunology, Neuroscience and
Cardiopulmonary.

Johnson & Johnson Innovative Medicine is leading where medicine is going. Patients inform and
inspire our science-based innovations, which continue to change and save lives. With rigorous
science and compassion, we confidently address the most complex diseases of our time and unlock the
medicines of tomorrow. Healthcare areas include: Oncology, Immunology, Neuroscience and
Cardiopulmonary.

  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]
    * [Medical Supply Distribution][55]
  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.
  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

### What is CheckerTR PRO?

CheckerTR PRO is an all-in-one GSM repair toolkit for professional technicians. It covers IMEI
repair, FRP bypass, data recovery, and flashing for most Android brands.

### Which brands are supported?

We support Samsung, Xiaomi, MediaTek, Qualcomm, Huawei, Oppo, Realme, Infinix, Tecno, and many other
brands with dedicated service modules.

### How can I get a license?

Licenses and credits are sold through our official reseller network. Check our [Authorized
Resellers][49] page for a distributor in your region.

#### About the COMSOL Product Suite

The COMSOL Multiphysics^{®} software brings a user interface and experience that is always the same,
regardless of engineering application and physics phenomena.

Add-on modules provide specialized functionality for electromagnetics, structural mechanics,
acoustics, fluid flow, heat transfer, and chemical engineering. Choose from a list of LiveLink™
products to interface directly with CAD and other third-party software. Deploy simulation
applications with COMSOL Compiler™ and COMSOL Server™.

Get to Know COMSOL

At COMSOL, we develop mathematical modeling software that drives new breakthroughs in physics and
engineering — and we love what we do.

Our mission is to provide easy-to-use software solutions to engineering problems and to help our
users get the most out of our products. We envision sustaining and reinforcing our position as a
leading provider and developer of mathematical modeling software. We also aim to make our technology
the primary tool for engineers, researchers, and lecturers within the fields of education and
high-tech product development.

**Quick Facts**
* Founded in 1986
* 16 offices and a distributor network throughout the world
* 500+ employees globally

# **about our company**

Founded in 2002, Dragon Crown Medical Co., Ltd. is a hi-tech enterprise integrating R&D, manufacture
and sales of medical products. 
From the first beginning, Dragon Crown has always focused on providing MISS overall solutions in
spine and joint surgery fields. Based on its strong R & D capability and innovative spirit, Dragon
Crown is equipped with more than 100 domestic and international patents, and has created a whole
industrial chain layout of design, R & D, production and sales.

[read more][133]
[[64e325cl63]][134]

##### **Why choose us**

With "precise MISS" as the core, the enterprise's products cover the field of minimally invasive
orthopaedic instruments and equipment, mainly including bone filling container, balloon catheter, 
remote controlled injection manipulator, expandable retractor, V-shaped multi-channel spinal
instruments, medical endoscope, camera system with matched instruments, orthopaedic shaver system
and accessories etc..  The market competitiveness of products has always been at the leading level
in the industry. Authorized by QM  GB/T 19001-2016 idt ISO 9001:2015 and YY/T 0287-2017 idt ISO
13485:2016, Vertebral Forming Unitized Surgical Instruments & Vertebroplasty Toolkit, Expandable
Retractor System, Bone Filling Container, and Remote Controlled Injection Manipulator, have already
obtained CE Certificate. DCM Kyphoplasty System  has already obtained FDA Certificate.

# Enjoy the Best Views in Austin from Mount Bonnell

#### From Mount Bonnell, the high point Austin TX, you have awesome views on Austin, the Colorado
#### River and the Texas Hill Country

[ Visit Mount Bonnell ][23]
 

### What to Do at Mount Bonnell

At the peak you will find Covert Park, an Austin view point with 360-degree views that include the
city skyline and Lake Austin. This free Austin Mount Bonnell experience attracts locals and tourists
from around the world and offers a variety of activities. There are plenty of nearby Lake Austin
hotels and luxury hotels in Austin to provide you with a memorable stay.

[ 10 Reasons to Visit Austin Mt Bonnell ][24]

## About Mount Bonnell

Bonnell Mountain is a great landmark and one of the most visited sites and tourist attractions in
Austin. The limestone height stands at 775 ft above sea level and is considered to be the highest
point within Austin City Limits. It has been a popular sightseeing destination since the mid-19th
century and continues to attract tourists and locals for mountain biking, hiking, and more on the
Mount Bonnel hiking trail. In fact, it’s a favorite for mountain bikers and a Mount Bonell hike is
on the bucket list of many tourists. Mount Bonnell also known as Covert Park belongs, next to other
parks such as Mueller Lake Park and Zilker Park, to the best parks in Austin.

Visit Mt. Bonnell Austin TX and Covert Park at Mount Bonnell trails and enjoy the beauty of the
Austin skyline. If you want to learn more, you can also buy one of many topographic maps with
elevation data and Austin TX Mount Bonnell directions. So, when tourists arrive and ask: Are there
mountains in Austin, Texas? You can tell them to get ready for an exciting walk on the Mt Bonell
stairs to the top. While you’re visiting Bonnell Austin, don’t forget to take in [Circuit of
Americas][25] Austin TX, the country’s premier destination for phenomenal motorsports and live
entertainment. If you’re a diehard sports fan, check out 104.9 The Horn Austin, it’s a local Austin
radio station with station broadcasts in sports format and is the flagship station of the Texas
Longhorns. If My Bonnell has given you an appetite for heights take a trip out to Texas Hill Country
to see the rural countryside of Central Texas with its rugged hills and native vegetation.

If you’re looking for accommodation, you’ll be spoilt for choice, from family hotels to five star
hotels in Austin. [Hotel Saint Cecilia][26] in Austin and [The Loren at Lady Bird Lake][27] both
offer upscale accommodations where you can recover after sightseeing in two of the best Austin
luxury hotels.

[ About Mount Bonnell ][28]

# Enjoy the Best Views in Austin from Mount Bonnell

#### From Mount Bonnell, the high point Austin TX, you have awesome views on Austin, the Colorado
#### River and the Texas Hill Country

[ Visit Mount Bonnell ][23]
 

### What to Do at Mount Bonnell

At the peak you will find Covert Park, an Austin view point with 360-degree views that include the
city skyline and Lake Austin. This free Austin Mount Bonnell experience attracts locals and tourists
from around the world and offers a variety of activities. There are plenty of nearby Lake Austin
hotels and luxury hotels in Austin to provide you with a memorable stay.

[ 10 Reasons to Visit Austin Mt Bonnell ][24]

## About Mount Bonnell

Bonnell Mountain is a great landmark and one of the most visited sites and tourist attractions in
Austin. The limestone height stands at 775 ft above sea level and is considered to be the highest
point within Austin City Limits. It has been a popular sightseeing destination since the mid-19th
century and continues to attract tourists and locals for mountain biking, hiking, and more on the
Mount Bonnel hiking trail. In fact, it’s a favorite for mountain bikers and a Mount Bonell hike is
on the bucket list of many tourists. Mount Bonnell also known as Covert Park belongs, next to other
parks such as Mueller Lake Park and Zilker Park, to the best parks in Austin.

Visit Mt. Bonnell Austin TX and Covert Park at Mount Bonnell trails and enjoy the beauty of the
Austin skyline. If you want to learn more, you can also buy one of many topographic maps with
elevation data and Austin TX Mount Bonnell directions. So, when tourists arrive and ask: Are there
mountains in Austin, Texas? You can tell them to get ready for an exciting walk on the Mt Bonell
stairs to the top. While you’re visiting Bonnell Austin, don’t forget to take in [Circuit of
Americas][25] Austin TX, the country’s premier destination for phenomenal motorsports and live
entertainment. If you’re a diehard sports fan, check out 104.9 The Horn Austin, it’s a local Austin
radio station with station broadcasts in sports format and is the flagship station of the Texas
Longhorns. If My Bonnell has given you an appetite for heights take a trip out to Texas Hill Country
to see the rural countryside of Central Texas with its rugged hills and native vegetation.

If you’re looking for accommodation, you’ll be spoilt for choice, from family hotels to five star
hotels in Austin. [Hotel Saint Cecilia][26] in Austin and [The Loren at Lady Bird Lake][27] both
offer upscale accommodations where you can recover after sightseeing in two of the best Austin
luxury hotels.

# Nanotherm Therapeutics

Developing technologies to precisely ablate solid tumors

###### Technology

## **Confirm *before *treating**: Next-level predictive tissue ablation using a clinically proven
## 2-step image guided therapy workflow

### 01 — Deliver

The nanoparticles are directly injected into the tumor, where their surface coating enables targeted
accumulation and retention within the tumor tissue.

### 02 — Confirm

Once delivered, the nanoparticle deposits remain in place and can be clearly visualized using
standard imaging techniques such as CT, EBUS, or CBCT.

### 03 — Predict

Prior to treatment, the external energy can be adjusted with defined parameters.  The goal of these
adjustments is to create a predictable ablation zone that reduces unnecessary tissue damage.

**Disclaimer:** The Nanotherm system is an investigational device and is not approved for commercial
clinical use in any jurisdiction. Any prior CE marking in the European Union has been discontinued
and does not imply current regulatory authorization.

### 01 — Activate

A contactless and adjustable alternating magnetic field stimulates the implanted nanoparticles to
heat. The energy deposited is defined only by the concentration, volume, and the magnetic field
strength.

### 02 — Ablate

The generated heat destroys target tissue contained within a defined zone preventing collateral
damage to sensitive adjacent structures.

###### Advantages

## Nanotherm is developing a thermal ablation method to treat solid tumors: Targeted thermal
## ablation enabled by nanoparticle activation.

### Simple clinical workflow

Treatment with the Nanotherm technology can be done one day. Our vision is to diagnose and treat
patients in the same day.

### Insensitive to motion

During treatment, patients breathe, their hearts beat, and they move. A tumor is literally a moving
target. Nanotherm allows for stable, controlled heating over time due to contact-less energy
delivery, making inaccurate real-time tumor tracking unnecessary.

### Tailored to target shape

Treatment based on the individual tumor volume and localization. Nanoparticles delivered via
universal 19G needle, as no antenna is needed to deliver energy, those technical restrictions are no
longer a concern for the ablation zone shape.

###### Product Suite

## The Nanotherm Technology has been demonstrated in over 200 patients.

### Nanotherm^{®}AS1

Bioengineered non-toxic nanoparticles are placed into tumor tissue and remain in place due to their
coating.

### NanoActivator™

RF energy heats the nanoparticles to either directly ablate tumor cells or enhance effectiveness of
conventional therapy.

# Nanotherm Therapeutics

Developing technologies to precisely ablate solid tumors

###### Technology

## **Confirm *before *treating**: Next-level predictive tissue ablation using a clinically proven
## 2-step image guided therapy workflow

### 01 — Deliver

The nanoparticles are directly injected into the tumor, where their surface coating enables targeted
accumulation and retention within the tumor tissue.

### 02 — Confirm

Once delivered, the nanoparticle deposits remain in place and can be clearly visualized using
standard imaging techniques such as CT, EBUS, or CBCT.

### 03 — Predict

Prior to treatment, the external energy can be adjusted with defined parameters.  The goal of these
adjustments is to create a predictable ablation zone that reduces unnecessary tissue damage.

**Disclaimer:** The Nanotherm system is an investigational device and is not approved for commercial
clinical use in any jurisdiction. Any prior CE marking in the European Union has been discontinued
and does not imply current regulatory authorization.

### 01 — Activate

A contactless and adjustable alternating magnetic field stimulates the implanted nanoparticles to
heat. The energy deposited is defined only by the concentration, volume, and the magnetic field
strength.

### 02 — Ablate

The generated heat destroys target tissue contained within a defined zone preventing collateral
damage to sensitive adjacent structures.

###### Advantages

## Nanotherm is developing a thermal ablation method to treat solid tumors: Targeted thermal
## ablation enabled by nanoparticle activation.

### Simple clinical workflow

Treatment with the Nanotherm technology can be done one day. Our vision is to diagnose and treat
patients in the same day.

### Insensitive to motion

During treatment, patients breathe, their hearts beat, and they move. A tumor is literally a moving
target. Nanotherm allows for stable, controlled heating over time due to contact-less energy
delivery, making inaccurate real-time tumor tracking unnecessary.

### Tailored to target shape

Treatment based on the individual tumor volume and localization. Nanoparticles delivered via
universal 19G needle, as no antenna is needed to deliver energy, those technical restrictions are no
longer a concern for the ablation zone shape.

###### Product Suite

## The Nanotherm Technology has been demonstrated in over 200 patients.

### Nanotherm^{®}AS1

Bioengineered non-toxic nanoparticles are placed into tumor tissue and remain in place due to their
coating.

### NanoActivator™

RF energy heats the nanoparticles to either directly ablate tumor cells or enhance effectiveness of
conventional therapy.

# The future of minimally invasive cancer treatment is today.

Now part of [Precision IO][14], Quantum Surgical presents Epione^{®}, a state-of-the art
robotic-assisted platform designed to transform interventional oncology.

[
Discover Epione
][15][Learn more about us][16]

## The Epione robotic-assisted percutaneous ablation platform

The Epione^{®} robotic-assisted platform supports interventional radiologists in **treating
inoperable or challenging early-staged tumors**, due to their size, shape or location, without any
surgical intervention.
‍

This cutting-edge technology guides physicians to perform **safe and effective percutaneous tumor
ablation**, a minimally invasive treatment in which one or multiple needles are inserted through the
skin to destroy the tumor.

Percutaneous ablation is underutilized as a first-line treatment for cancer patients due to
procedural workflow limitations and complexities. Epione is designed to overcome these challenges.

Now** **[**indicated for musculoskeletal (MSK) procedures**][17]*, Epione offers a new approach for
bone ablation and consolidation.

[Learn more.][18]

Learn more about how percutaneous ablation benefits patients.

Dr. Romain L'Huilier
Hospices Civils de Lyon (Lyon, France)

The technical difficulty involved in placing the needle (or needles) is reduced, and **I can focus
on patient safety and the oncological efficacy of tumour destruction.**

[Oncolab][22]

Hospices Civils de Lyon (Lyon, France)

**The needles are placed exactly where we predicted they would be**. With the human hand, the
needles are approximately where we predicted

[France 3][23]
Prof. Thierry de Baere
Gustave Roussy (Villejuif, France)

With Epione, you just have to identify the volume of the tumor, click on the center of it, and pick
the number of needles that you’re going to use. It gives you a trajectory for all needles that
you’re going to place. **Everything is done with one click, so it saves a significant amount of
time.**

[Cancer Network article][24]
Dr. Govindarajan Narayanan
Baptist Health (Miami, USA)

[Epione] will enable us to push back the boundaries. These treatments are confined to very expert
hands, and the idea behind it is to **be able to democratize these treatments and give access to
these minimally invasive technologies, to as many patients as possible.**

[BFM Marseille][25]
Dr. Gilles Piana
Institut Paoli-Calmettes (Marseille, France)

[Epione] makes it possible to target very small or poorly placed tumors that were previously almost
inaccessible. **Around 20% of the 70 people we have already operated would not have been possible
before.**

[Article Le Monde][26]
Prof. Laurent Milot
Hospices Civils de Lyon (Lyon, France)

What does Quantum Surgical do?

Quantum Surgical is a French company specializing in medical robotics and AI, co-founded in 2017 by
Bertin Nahum, CEO.

With a dynamic team of over 130 employees, the company is headquartered in Montpellier, France, and
has offices in Miami, Florida. Its Epione platform is dedicated to the curative and early treatment
of cancers.
‍

Quantum Surgical offers a new approach to cancer treatment by standardizing access to care. More
patients can benefit from innovative, better-targeted, and less invasive treatments. Hundreds of
patients have already been treated worldwide.

What is a percutaneous ablation?

Percutaneous ablation is a technique part of interventional oncology and an alternative to surgery.
It involves the insertion of a thin needle or probe through the skin (percutaneously) and into the
targeted area to destroy or remove the tumor. It makes it possible to treat tumors that are
particularly difficult to reach, due to their size or their location.

RoboDK offers all the features required create your Digital Twin quickly and accurately.

[RoboDK robot]
* [
  
  ### Robot Simulation & Offline Programming
  
  Create robot simulations and robot programs for any robot arm in minutes. You can easily and
  accurately simulate your robot arms with RoboDK software.
  
  ][52]
* [
  
  ### Robot Machining
  
  Use robots for manufacturing applications such as robot machining or 3D printing. Simulate and
  convert 5-axis CNC programs such as G-Code or APT-CLS for your robot controller.
  
  ][53]
* [
  
  ### Robot Programs
  
  Easily generate robot programs offline for any robot controller. You don't need to learn
  vendor-specific programming anymore.
  
  ][54]
* [
  
  ### Support 3D Models
  
  Import 3D models in formats such as STL, STEP, and IGES, and accurately create your Digital Twin.
  
  ][55]
* [
  
  ### Post Processors
  
  RoboDK Post Processors include support for many robot controllers, including ABB RAPID (mod/prg),
  Fanuc (LS/TP), KUKA KRC (SRC), Motoman Inform (JBI), Universal Robots (URP/script) and much more!
  
  ][56]
* [
  
  ### External Axes
  
  Easily integrate and simulate robots with external axes to extend the reachability of your robot.
  
  ][57]
* [
  
  ### Robot Accuracy
  
  Calibrate your robot arm to improve accuracy up to 0.100 mm. RoboDK software combines all the
  simulation and calibration features in one solution.
  
  ][58]
* [
  
  ### Avoid Singularities and Collisions
  
  Easily create your Digital Twin offline and prevent the robot from going through singularities,
  axis limits and collisions.
  
  ][59]
* [
  
  ### RoboDK API
  
  Create robot programs using modern programming languages such as Python, C# or C++. Software
  developers can easily customize the interface.
  
  ][60]

Dynasties. Adhering to the artisan spirit of “pursuing excellence and prioritizing quality,” the

portfolio centers on high-frequency equipment and instruments, establishing a unique product line
that serves multiple clinical departments. ShouLiang-med is committed to providing safe and
high-quality comprehensive solutions for clinical treatment.
